script_text: Stop! Cancer, the Moon is sounding an alarm in your chart right now. Your ruling planet, the Moon, is in Pisces in your 9th House, forming a challenging square to Mars in your 10th House of Career and Public Status, igniting a power play. This water sign energy clashes with fiery ambition, creating tension between your emotional needs and professional demands. If you're taken, avoid discussing long-term commitments tonight; your partner may feel pressured by sudden career talk. If single, you attract someone mysterious through travel or education—keep your eyes open in a classroom or workshop setting this evening. Mars square your Moon in the 10th House signals a power struggle with a boss or authority figure. Don't sign financial contracts involving shared resources until the aspect passes. Avoid letting workplace stress spill into your home sanctuary. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
